caseNameFull: Baumann v. Smrha, Chief Engineer, Division of Water Resources, Kansas State Board of Agriculture
attorneys: Kenneth G. Speir and Herbert H. Sizemore for appellants. John Anderson, Jr., Attorney General of Kansas, Paul E. Wilson, Assistant Attorney General, and Warden L. Noe, Special Assistant Attorney General, for Smrha, and Robt. B. Morton and Paul J. Donaldson for the City of Wichita, appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Reed and Mr. Justice Douglas would note probable jurisdiction.
